title: Diagnosis: replication package for Search-based Trace Diagnostic for Cyber-Physical Systems
description: Inputs, archived raw outputs, executable configurations, a frozen tool snapshot, and analysis code for the Diagnosis evaluation. Evidence gaps are explicitly identified in CLAIMS.md and ARTIFACT_EVALUATION.md.
